Something’s cooking in the lab 🧪🤗

We’re getting ready to launch a reproduction hackathon for NeurIPS 2026 papers, powered by ML Intern.

The idea is simple: pick a claim from a paper, try to reproduce it, and share what you find. Verified, falsified, or inconclusive, every honest reproduction attempt counts.

More details very soon. We are very excited!
